description: This file is a code-behind partial class for a Blazor Razor component, managing catalog items including listing, details, create, edit, and delete functionalities.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Partial class for handling catalog item list and related operations in a Blazor component.

methods.name: OnAfterRenderAsync
methods.description: Overrides base method to load catalog data after the component is first rendered.

methods.name: DetailsClick
methods.description: Handles the event to show details of a catalog item.

methods.name: CreateClick
methods.description: Handles the event to open create catalog item dialog.

methods.name: EditClick
methods.description: Handles the event to open edit dialog for a specific catalog item.

methods.name: DeleteClick
methods.description: Handles the event to open delete confirmation for a catalog item.

methods.name: ReloadCatalogItems
methods.description: Refreshes the list of catalog items from the service.
